text: Surely not news to everyone, but I just saw that boost has real JSON support now: <https://www.boost.org/doc/libs/develop/libs/json/doc/html/index.html>

elements.text: I wrote a property tree replacement, for json, xml and info object serializations, with or without pretty spacing. But I didn't do parsing. With this though we can easily layer over http for the compat interface.

elements.text: The json has full data type support (to the extent json has data types), but limited XML to elements only.
